scientific_interpretation: Independent generator realizations reproduce the state-level three-way direction well enough for the frozen within-state gate.
Independent reviewers do not reproduce the exact material-better versus tie threshold well enough for a single-pair hard-label contract.
The failure is component-specific: RS exact agreement is 1.0 while ME exact agreement is 0.375.
The result does not show that resources never help and does not isolate the semantic encoder as the primary bottleneck.
prohibited: declaring the original D2 gate passed by replacing its exact three-way metric with a posthoc binary metric
editing or adjudicating isolated disagreements after unblinding to cross the threshold
creating canonical single-realization hard effect labels from this measurement design
using the D2 outcomes to choose seeds, samples, feature definitions, RAG cards, memory contents, or external-test cases
starting an open-ended encoder or hyperparameter race on these 32 states

bounded_zero_new_human_recovery.purpose: Test whether a soft expected-benefit target has a learnable directional relationship with the already frozen transparent candidate-aware features before authorizing D3 expansion.
bounded_zero_new_human_recovery.same_pair_multiple_reviewers: Average reviewer scores within the same generated pair; reviewers are repeated measurements, not independent generator outcomes.
bounded_zero_new_human_recovery.state_soft_target: Average the available independent generated-pair scores within each state after within-pair reviewer averaging.
bounded_zero_new_human_recovery.scope: Diagnostic only: eight states per component cannot promote a final PM.
required_reporting: strict three-way D2 failure remains the primary measurement result
soft-target diagnostic is labeled as a pre-D3 recovery analysis
results are reported by component and user group

packet_repairs_before_any_D3: canonicalize decisive_criterion enum names in manifest, HTML, blank annotations, and analyzer
reject visibly truncated or broken dialogue turns before freezing a packet
retain empty current_session_summary because complete current-session dialogue is the frozen baseline and resource evidence remains hidden from blind reviewers

decision_after_zero_cost_diagnostic.no_direction: Narrow V1.5 to audited resource-effect measurement and routing feasibility; do not expand data or change encoder.
decision_after_zero_cost_diagnostic.direction_present: Freeze a bounded D3 repeated-outcome protocol before any generation, with outcome-blind state selection, user-group splits, a predefined judge calibration and minimal human audit, atomic risk review, and deterministic cost gates.
